item.title: 300,000 Acres Burned in Wildfires Across Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas
item.description: AMARILLO, TX — Wildfires that have raged across Kansas and the panhandles of Texas and Oklahoma have burned more than 300,000 acres this week.Drought conditions and high winds added fuel to the fires, which became so intense that smoke and dust could be seen from space in NASA images. item.title: Goodfellow AFB to Hold Emergency Response Training Exercise
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The 17th Security Forces Squadron will conduct an emergency response training exercise at the base chapel from noon to 4 p.m. Saturday, Feb. 21. Base officials said residents near the installation may notice an increased presence of emergency responders and hear announcements over the “giant voice” loudspeaker system. Delays are possible at the Jacobson Gate during the exercise. Learn More Here.

item.title: Gov. Abbott Announces Federal Assistance For 8 Ball Fire
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — The Federal Emergency Management Agency has approved a Fire Management Assistance Grant for the 8 Ball Fire burning in the Texas Panhandle, Gov. Greg Abbott announced Friday.The wildfire began in Armstrong County and spread into neighboring Donley County, threatening homes and infrastructure and prompting evacuations in nearby communities. Learn More Here.

item.title: More Than 700 Rainbow Trout Stocked in Concho River Downtown
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — More than 700 rainbow trout were stocked in the Concho River downtown Friday, Feb. 20, by the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department in the final planned trout stocking of the season.The fish were stocked at the Oakes Street Lake, 396 S. Irving St. Learn More Here.

item.title: Man Sues Shannon Hospital Over Objects Left in Body After Surgery
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A Brown County man who suffered a workplace gunshot wound in 2022 has sued Shannon Medical Center, its management company, and three physicians, alleging medical negligence led to a prolonged infection after foreign material was left in his body following surgery. Learn More Here.

item.title: Garage Fire in North San Angelo Knocks Out Power in Neighborhood
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A garage fire in north San Angelo on Friday afternoon caused at least five homes in the neighborhood to lose electricity.The fire began about 4 p.m. on Bowie Street near its intersection with 26th Street.Three fire engine trucks, a rescue truck and an ambulance responded to the scene, along with police vehicles to help block traffic. Learn More Here.

item.title: Central’s Reel Sets School Record, Reaches Finals at State Swimming Meet
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — San Angelo Central’s Elsa Reel qualified for the finals in both of her events Friday at the UIL Swimming & Diving Class 6A State Meet, setting a new school record in the process.Reel swam the 200-yard individual medley in a time of 2 minutes, 2.3 seconds to finish third in the prelims and set the school record. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 1 Wall Overcomes Tolar to Claim an Area Championship
item.description: BAIRD, TX — In the Area matchup against Tolar in Baird on Friday night, the No. 1-ranked Wall Lady Hawks found themselves trailing at halftime for one of the few times this season. Slow shooting early on, combined with a hot start from Tolar, put the Lady Hawks in an unfamiliar position. However, with adversity came the chance to overcome it, and the Lady Hawks delivered. Wall smothered Tolar in the final two quarters to claim an Area Championship, 58-42. Learn More Here.
